product_metadata.title: V&LX 14 Inch High (Queen) Mattress Support/Metal Slat Bed Frame with Head Support/No Boxspring Needed(Queen)
features: This Deluxe 11-leg Head supporting Bar Bed Frame (added 2 legs in the middle of Standard Bed Frame, in order to upgrade more supporting) supports your deluxe mattress for long-last and can hold over 800 LBS
Plastic Floor protectors are applied at the bottom of all legs, no scratches on your floor and Rounded edges with plastic Protector on the top of front legs prevents bumping into sharp corners.
Frame is designed to encase mattress by 5mm deep and Metal slats have double-sided adhesive tape to keep a mattress from sliding
By applying noise-free plastic cover on every edge of slats (red and black), when you turn and toss in sleeping, it does not make noise. ample space under bed (12.5 inches) for your storage
Warranty manufacturer limited 5 year, Please Peel off The Upper Strip(Antislip Tape) on Slats
description: -This sturdy, stable and durable metal platform bed with steel slats replace a box spring. No box spring needed. Hold 800 LBS based on static test result -This Bed Frame Supports standard mattress size hold : Twin 75 x 39 inches , Full 75 x 54 inches, Queen 80 x 60 inches, King 80 x 76 inches , outer size of bed frame is bigger than standard mattress size above by around 2 inches. -This is the best choice for modern compact bedroom with ample space under bed for storage of stuff, traveler bag, or boxes
